reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-random. I said I'd noted that the deadline for Tansley Parcel's signed order form is 3 April, not the date they posted in #central-team this morning. They said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

A deadline date isn't a money term, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel. I didn't look at #central-team or change anything there, which means the wrong date they posted earlier is still showing.
